title: Reliable reusable phases with source-derived decomposition and complete delivery

baseline_observations.interpretation: Historical later-path findings define required behavior, not proof of identical baseline defects or a prescribed file layout.

problem: Taskplane must derive tasks from verified dependencies and carry complete, admissible, authorized results through release with fresh reusable phase executions, honest recovery, and actual native-host evidence.
users: maintainers reviewing PR and release evidence

functional_requirements.requirement: Verify current source touchpoints and bounded dependency coverage before decomposition; distinguish observed source, verified proposals, and realized candidate facts.
Derive task scope, ownership, dependencies, and order from connected impacted subgraphs; close actual cut edges and declared worker/task/phase/runtime seams.
Consume integrated candidate conformance and exact production boundary proofs; support honestly bounded standalone Review without invented Plan approval.
C: apply canonical substantive finding policy after provenance validation and append revalidation of relied-on historical passes.
E: preserve truthful reason, effects, identity, prerequisites, and authorized continuation; distinguish waits/correction/setup/authority and stop unchanged failing retries.
A: persist complete produced/inherited artifacts, actual quality strategy bytes, full accessible evidence, and applicable authority for fresh successors.
B: reconcile owner/reviewer setup and pickup, all durable records, native identity/capability/observations, and uncertain external effects before readiness; reject changed-input replay.
D: support many-to-many contributions, multiple exact proofs, accountable acceptance ownership, and separate joint integration evidence.
Connect Product, Design, Plan, Build, Review, Retro, and Release or declared final outcome through explicit durable results and continuation without private predecessor runtime.
Use one explicit applicable policy separating produced work, mechanical validation, authorized progression, and human sign-off; preserve history and recorded scope-valid authority.
Reuse incumbent small-responsibility capabilities with one active owner, explicit historical compatibility, retired paths, and bounded migration/rollback.
Report identity-bound progress, effects, waits, corrections, replay, timing, evidence gaps, and provider/cache usage honestly without double-counting.

Deliver through current-source Design, exact owned acceptance/proof mapping, bounded PRs, all six labeled journeys, independent final review, scoped sign-off, Retro, and separately authorized release.

priority_order.label: C
priority_order.reason: Restore trust in acceptance decisions first.

priority_order.label: E
priority_order.reason: Make continuation accurate and prevent blind non-progress.

priority_order.label: A
priority_order.reason: Supply the artifacts and authority successors actually require.

priority_order.label: B
priority_order.reason: Reconcile required records and uncertain host effects consistently.

priority_order.label: D
priority_order.reason: Remove invalid planning restrictions without weakening acceptance.

priority_dependency_rule: Priority guides risk treatment, not permission to bypass dependencies. Design may order prerequisites differently only with an explicit dependency and acceptance rationale.

phase_behavior.input: Explicit versioned artifacts, scope/authority, output requirements, and any durable checkpoint.
phase_behavior.processing: Phase-specific expertise transforms inputs into declared outputs.
phase_behavior.validation: Integrity and domain validation, independent review where applicable, and an explicit authorization policy.
phase_behavior.result: Complete durable produced/inherited artifacts, full accessible evidence, unresolved issues, attempt/candidate provenance, completion status, and exact continuation.
phase_behavior.distinction: Produced output, mechanical validity, authorized progression, and human sign-off are distinct facts.
phase_behavior.extensibility: A phase using existing capabilities requires definition, processing, and domain validation without changing shared dispatch, pickup, storage, hooks, or lifecycle behavior.

nfr_by_lens.security: Treat paths, symlinks, selectors, manifests, host events, and portable evidence as untrusted; enforce containment, exact provenance/identity, and current authority before effects/recovery. Hashes and copied local receipts are not transferable authentication.
nfr_by_lens.architecture: One active owner per migrated lifecycle/graph/seam/finding/acceptance responsibility; reuse incumbent small units and distinguish proposed/as-built truth. No additional framework, coordinator, store, parallel authority, or arbitrary module-count target.
nfr_by_lens.integrability: Exact versioned producer/consumer contracts, full portable artifacts/evidence, multiple contributions/proofs, typed refusals, additive/breaking classification, and deterministic eligible historical migration/revalidation; no silent drift.
nfr_by_lens.data-safety: Preserve immutable requirements, approvals, passes, and artifacts; append revalidation, reconcile interrupted operations, reject changed-input replay, preserve completed work, and bound rollback without dual owners.
nfr_by_lens.sre: Bound traversal/correction, expose degraded capability/evidence and precise continuation, test persistence/effect failures and duplicate events, stop identical failing retries, and preserve legitimate waits.
nfr_by_lens.privacy-compliance: Export only necessary telemetry/diagnostics and safe reason codes with provenance; no secrets, full prompts/transcripts, private predecessor runtime, or copied authentication authority.
nfr_by_lens.cost-finops: Default graph depth 3 and explicit traversal/fan-out/time limits; avoid unnecessary whole-repository scans/worker fan-out; deduplicate replay and record available provider/cache counters according to their actual semantics.
nfr_by_lens.qa: Six production-boundary journeys with positive/targeted-severed evidence and current candidate binding; label real/simulated evidence and never use consumer fixtures, suite counts, skips, or synthetic observations to claim real host completion.

acceptance_criteria.title: Verified bounded source coverage
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Source touchpoints are verified once per bound input before decomposition. Default depth is 3; parser, language, ambiguity, policy, depth, fan-out, time, missing, unsupported, and rejected limits are explicit. Identical inputs yield deterministic semantic results and partial coverage is never complete.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Use bounded source/graph fixtures with changed, missing, ambiguous, unsupported, and truncated input; reject unverified proposals.

acceptance_criteria.title: Dependency-derived tasks and complete seams
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Connected impacted subgraphs determine task ownership/order; extensions are verified before expansion. Each cut edge/runtime seam has exact nodes/symbols, schema/version, cardinality, both owners, direction/order, distinct positive/severed selectors, and source/graph/requirement/Design/Plan/candidate provenance.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Public readiness rejects omitted nodes/edges, orphan/duplicate producers or consumers, wrong direction/order, unowned rows, and stale/incomplete bindings.

acceptance_criteria.title: Integrated realized conformance
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Proposed overlays remain distinct from integrated as-built truth. Conformance detects added, removed/missing, changed, reversed, stale, and unexpected seams, including separately passing task diffs with a shared-contract mismatch.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Engineering cannot approve before consuming current conformance and all seam proofs; overlay identity swaps or removed evidence bindings must block the public result.

acceptance_criteria.title: Faithful production-boundary proof
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Every required worker/task/phase/runtime seam is proven using actual upstream production output and a distinct one-edge severance that makes the same public behavior fail.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Reject missing, stale, foreign, multi-edge, ceremonial, or non-failing severance and consumer-only fabricated boundary claims; missing/unexecutable required runtime probes remain blocking gaps.

acceptance_criteria.title: Standalone review and compatibility
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Review without Plan derives current source/diff seams without inventing Plan authority, and labels declared/derived, partial, timed-out, unsupported, and truncated coverage. Eligible historical graph/evaluation-evidence/wiring records have deterministic migration or revalidation.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Standalone and historical-generation fixtures preserve originals and reject a second graph, seam, or evidence authority.

acceptance_criteria.title: Entry, native capability, and identity
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Supported CLI/native launchers preserve selected valid engine, arguments, contract, and enforcement; absent/invalid/ambiguous candidates fail before effects. Host capability precedes readiness; runs/replacement attempts have unique native identities, children bind owner attempts, and exact replay retains identity.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify launcher/capability cases, a fresh real native spawn, foreign/broken identity refusals without widened authority, and duplicate events converging through one effective observation owner.

acceptance_criteria.title: C: substantive review admissibility
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Canonical finding classification/blocking policy follows provenance validation. Pass labels cannot override policy-blocking unresolved findings or missing evidence; legitimate non-blocking debt/observations remain visible. Resolution needs current linked evidence.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Contradictory public collection fixtures yield equal decisions for equal applicable classifications; append revalidation of relied-on historical passes, preserve originals, and mark unavailable retained evidence unverified.

acceptance_criteria.title: E: truthful authorized recovery
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Refusals preserve safe reason, phase/attempt, committed/observed/pending/uncertain effects, permitted continuation/prerequisites, and same-versus-replacement semantics. Missing terminal evidence names observation/wait/reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Public failures distinguish wait, artifact correction, setup repair, and authority request; execution rechecks authority, unchanged retry preserves identity/completed work, repeated identical failure stops without progress, and legitimate waits use a named event mechanism.

acceptance_criteria.title: A: complete producer result
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Normal quality-enabled Design seals actual strategy bytes, all required produced/inherited artifacts, accessible evidence, and applicable quality authority. Fresh Plan and Build consume only the package through public interfaces.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Remove, alter, or stale required artifacts and require a specific producer-completion or successor-admission refusal; no predecessor runtime access or inserted artifact, receipt, or permission repairs the production connection.

acceptance_criteria.title: B: recoverable attempts
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Owner/reviewer setup/pickup reconcile every required record before readiness. Same-operation replay repairs setup or returns the valid prior result, while changed input under the identity is refused.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Parameterize relevant phases/roles with fault injection at local persistence and external-effect boundaries; reconcile uncertain host work before another launch, report unavailable reconciliation precisely, and make no exactly-once remote claim.

acceptance_criteria.title: D: contributions and acceptance
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Many-to-many task/criterion contributions support several exact proofs and separately required joint integration evidence. Accountable acceptance ownership does not exclude contributors; task completion is distinct from acceptance.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Public Plan/Build/acceptance cases block missing contributions/proofs, stale candidate, or missing joint proof; task completions alone cannot accept, and distinct shell commands are not guessed equivalent.

acceptance_criteria.title: J1: real native start through collection
acceptance_criteria.requirement: An authorized supported real host supplies genuine observed start/identity, terminal evidence, and actual collected output through production interfaces.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Record real host/evidence provenance; missing identity/terminal yields exact refusal without fabricated completion or duplicate launch. Unsupported capability is refused before readiness and unverified; simulation or skip cannot satisfy this criterion.

acceptance_criteria.title: J2: quality Design to Plan to Build
acceptance_criteria.requirement: A fresh execution trace carries actual Design-selected strategy, complete outputs, and quality authority into fresh Plan and Build.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Exercise removed/altered-artifact failure through the same production connection. Label host mode and evidence origin; simulated host tests cannot substitute for J1 or J6.

acceptance_criteria.title: J3: interruption and pickup
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Production-entry traces cover owner/reviewer roles and applicable phases, fresh pickup, duplicate events, cancellation, and interruption, preserving logical operation identity.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Inject faults at relevant persistence/effect boundaries and assert readiness records, launch counts, uncertain effects, and explicit real/simulated labels for each trace.

acceptance_criteria.title: J4: rejected review and bounded correction
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Production collection refuses pass-with-blocker and progresses only through a bounded authorized correction to a corrected candidate with sufficient current evidence.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify unchanged failure preserves identity/completed work and stops blind retries; retain correction authority, real/simulated labels, and unresolved evidence gaps.

acceptance_criteria.title: J5: multiple tasks and proofs
acceptance_criteria.requirement: An actual Plan-produced many-to-many/multiple-proof package reaches Build and aggregate acceptance with joint behavior evidence.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Delete each required contribution/proof or change candidate identity and require the same journey to block; no fixture rewrites the producer package to bypass checks, and mode is labeled.

acceptance_criteria.title: J6: real finalization
acceptance_criteria.requirement: On a supported real host, production Build output provides full accessible evidence to fresh Evaluate, independent Engineering review, applicable scoped human sign-off, Retro, and the declared Release/Publish/final outcome.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Missing downstream evidence/authority blocks at its boundary. Prove PR-based delivery and separately authorized publication; Build-only results, documents, synthetic terminals, old approval, or skips cannot satisfy the journey.

acceptance_criteria.title: Authority and retained obligations
acceptance_criteria.requirement: All supported paths distinguish draft/interrupted output, mechanical validity, and attributed progression authority under the explicit applicable policy; recovery rechecks recorded scope-valid authorization.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Reject predecessor conversations/runtime, old Design/Plan/approvals/reviews/completion claims, and stale fingerprints as current authority. Retain R-0004 and R-0001/R-0003 dependencies; keep P14 native canary and P23 whole-suite adjudication separately open.

acceptance_criteria.title: Modest reuse and bounded migration
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Each proposed unit maps one responsibility and explicit inputs/outputs to incumbent capabilities and acceptance checks. Each bounded migration PR names superseded inactive/removed paths, compatibility, and rollback.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Add a phase via definition/processing/domain validation using existing capabilities without shared dispatch/pickup/storage/hook/lifecycle changes; review rejects competing owners, unexplained infrastructure, or silent historical-authority reinterpretation.

acceptance_criteria.title: Honest telemetry and privacy
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Record run/phase/attempt/operation/candidate identity, continuation, timing, actual terminal outcome, last progress/wait, correction/replay counts, uncertain effects, missing evidence, and next permitted action.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Replay/duplicate-event cases count attempts/provider usage once; usage has provenance/cache semantics, unavailable stays unavailable, and exported diagnostics omit secrets, full prompts, transcripts, and predecessor private runtime.

acceptance_criteria.title: Fresh Product and Design handoff
acceptance_criteria.requirement: The manual spec/intake are the only current Product deliverables, with no canonical registration or approval. Later authorized registration retains scope; former Design/Plan remain historical.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Review the artifacts for complete original-criterion/journey mappings and no claimed code/runtime/Git/authority mutation. Fresh Design must bind source, assign exact owned positive/negative selectors, and settle policy/compatibility/rollout before applicable gates.

journeys.title: Real native start and terminal
journeys.positive: Authorized actual start/identity, terminal, and collected output.
journeys.failure: Missing identity/terminal refuses without fabrication or duplicate launch; unsupported capability stays unverified.

journeys.title: Quality Design to Plan to Build
journeys.positive: Actual Design-produced complete strategy/output/authority package reaches fresh Plan and Build.
journeys.failure: Removed/altered required artifact blocks the same production connection; simulated evidence cannot substitute for J1/J6.

journeys.title: Interrupted setup and replay
journeys.positive: Same-operation fresh pickup reconciles owner/reviewer and applicable phases.
journeys.failure: Faults at persistence/effect boundaries, cancellation, and duplicate events cannot yield false readiness or duplicate work; assert records/launch counts.

journeys.title: Rejected review and bounded correction
journeys.positive: Authorized bounded correction produces an admissible current candidate.
journeys.failure: Pass-with-blocker refuses; unchanged failure preserves attempt/work and stops retries; gaps remain explicit.

journeys.title: Multiple tasks and proofs
journeys.positive: Production Plan package reaches Build and aggregate acceptance with joint evidence.
journeys.failure: Missing contribution/proof, stale candidate, or incomplete joint evidence blocks without fixture package rewriting.

journeys.title: Real Build through finalization
journeys.positive: Full Build evidence reaches fresh Evaluate, independent Engineering, applicable human sign-off, Retro, and PR-based declared final outcome.
journeys.failure: Missing evidence/authority blocks; Build-only results, documents, synthetic terminal events, skips, and historical approval cannot satisfy.

dependency_obligations.deduplication: R-0004 is repeated in the source; retain one dependency without dropping its substantive obligations.

obligations.requirement: Revalidate current source touchpoints and bounded graph coverage before source-derived ownership/order or expansion.
Carry exact worker/task/phase/runtime producer-consumer contracts, proposed/realized truth, integrated conformance, and positive/severed evidence.
Bind fresh Design and Plan to the current source, candidate, acceptance map, compatible boundary versions, approval policy, and owned exact selectors.
Establish actual native host capability, identity, start/terminal observation and reconciliation through scoped implementation; missing transport evidence does not block Product drafting.
Carry full accessible evidence and applicable authority through independent Review, human sign-off where required, Retro, PR-based delivery, and separately authorized publication.
Preserve original requirement/history and separately open P14 native canary and P23 whole-suite adjudication; do not claim inherited completion.

dependency_obligations.external_service_internals: Not prescribed; only supported host boundary behavior is in scope.

contract_version_note: IDs are preserved from R-0005, separate from relation. No ID or canonical record is allocated. Design must verify 2.19.0 availability and classify compatibility; preserved names do not assert those versions already exist.
exclusions: No Taskplane runtime, contracts, receipts, registry, gates, or Git mutation during this manual Product task.
No code implementation, Design, Plan, self-approval, release, or publication in Product.
No inherited authority from old Design/Plan, conversations, private runtime, approvals, reviews, completion claims, or stale fingerprints.
No imposed removed module paths, generic workflow framework, new coordinator/store, parallel authority, or arbitrary module/line-count targets.
No unrelated features, external-service internals, unnecessary whole-repository scans, worker fan-out, or ritual full-catalog review wave.
No direct push to main or publication without applicable separate authorization.
No fabricated host observations, success from simulation/skip where real proof is required, guessed command equivalence, or invented usage.
No secrets, full prompts/transcripts, private predecessor runtime, or authentication authority exported as ordinary portable evidence.
No implied closure of P14 native canary or P23 whole-suite adjudication.

scope_handoff.exact_implementation_paths: Fresh Design must resolve from current source; historical removed paths are not immutable scope.

dod.reason: Fresh Design/Plan must assign exact owned public positive/negative selectors before implementation. No Product-only command substitutes for behavior verification.

open_questions.question: Which explicit approval policy applies to each supported path, scope-valid reuse, drafts, independent review, human sign-off, and publishing authority?
open_questions.constraint: Do not invent or waive authorization.

open_questions.question: Which native host/version and production observation contract provide actual identity/start/terminal evidence, and what scoped transport changes are required?
open_questions.constraint: Unsupported capability remains an implementation/evidence gap; no simulated replacement for J1/J6.

open_questions.question: Which boundary versions exist in 2.19.0, which historical generations remain readable, and which bounded migrations are additive or breaking?
open_questions.constraint: Identify one active owner, retired paths, and rollback for each slice.

open_questions.question: What exact owned public positive/negative selectors and dependency-ordered PR slices demonstrate all criteria and journeys against the candidate?
open_questions.constraint: Establish known failing boundary cases before coordination changes; preserve C to E to A to B to D risk priority.
